mapper.select: SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, FIN_PRODUCT.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, FIN_RATE_INFO.BASIS Basis, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY CCY, pa.prod_manager createUser, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE FINPRODTYPE, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPRODTYPE2, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE mdate, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PTLID, FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE vdate, ad.DEAL_MODE dealMode, PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT pa on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = pa.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ad on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ad.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PTL ON PTL.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 ='02' AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 ='C02' AND FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = '0' LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_RATE_INFO.CASH_ID AND (FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE IS NULL OR FIN_RATE_INFO.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE) WHERE 1=1 AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = trim(#{finprodCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
SELECT PROFIT_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 AND FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND FINPROD_MARKET_ID = trim(#{finprodCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT A.indexNo, A.FINPROD_ID, A.remainPrinAmt, A.reduceAmt, A.CUSTOM_LEVEL, A.AMT_MIN, A.AMT_MAX, A.TERM_MAX, A.TERM_MIN, to_char(A.vDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, to_char(A.mDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, A.interest FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN T1.OPERATION_TYPE = '01' then to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') ELSE t3.BRANCH || '' END indexNo, T1.FINPROD_ID, T3.remainPrinAmt, T3.remainPrinAmt reduceAmt, T3.interest-NVL(t5.intamt,0) interest, nvl(t4.intdate,T1.VDATE) vDate, #{tradeDate} mDate, T2.CUSTOM_LEVEL, T2.AMT_MIN, T2.AMT_MAX, T2.TERM_MAX, T2.TERM_MIN FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT bok.finprod_id, --nvl(f.branch, t.branch) branch, null branch, bok.tdy_prin_amt remainPrinAmt, bok.tdy_unpaid_intincexp interest FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD bok
WHERE bok.cdate = #{tradeDate} -1 and bok.tdy_prin_amt > 0 and bok.finprod_id = #{finprodId}) T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( select deal.finprod_id,max(settle_date) intdate from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps = #{C7} and settle_date <=#{tradeDate} and (deal.is_cancel ='N' or deal.is_cancel is null) group by deal.finprod_id ) T4 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( select deal.finprod_id,sum(deal.trade_amt) intamt from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps = #{C7} and deal.settle_date=#{tradeDate} and (deal.is_cancel ='N' OR DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL) group by deal.finprod_id )T5 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T1.VDATE <= #{tradeDate}) A

select distinct A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, b.vdate PayintStartDate, b.mdate PayintEndDate, A.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, A.CCY CCY, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE from FIN_PRODUCT A left join FIN_CASH_PLAN B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID where B.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and B.mdate = #{payintEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} and A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16'

SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, B.UNITVALUE_DEC unitvalueDec, C.PUR_SPEED purSpeed, A.CCY ccy, A.VDATE vDate, A.MDATE mDate, C.IS_CYCLE isCycle, A.OPERATION_TYPE operationType, A.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, pa.PROD_MANAGER prodmanager, F.BASIS basis FROM FIN_PRODUCT A left join fin_rate_info F on A.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT pa on A.FINPROD_ID = pa.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PTL ON PTL.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PTLAUTH ON PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTLAUTH.PORTFOLIO_ID, PRD_VAL_PARAM B,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = trim(#{finprodCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT A.BONU_SCALC_FLAG, A.BONUS_PLAN_ID, A.BASE_DATE, A.DEL_DATE, A.REG_DATE, A.VLU_REF_DATE, A.BONUS_DATE, A.UNIT_BONUS_VLU, A.TOTAL_AMT, A.IS_NET_MORMALIZE, A.REMARK, B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, B.FINPROD_ABBR, B.FINPROD_NAME, B.FINPROD_ID, padd.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, C.TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP, D.TDY_UNIT_VALUE, D.TDY_SHARE_AMT, B.CCY, D1.actTotalAmt, D1.actUnitBonusVlu, d1.regDateNum, D2.totalBonusCashAmt, D1.TRADE_ID bTradeId FROM PRD_BONUS_PLAN_N A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD C ON A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND TO_CHAR(A.BASE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_CHAR(C.CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') LEFT JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND TO_CHAR(A.VLU_REF_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_CHAR(D.CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') LEFT JOIN (SELECT D1.TRADE_ID,D1.B_TRADE_ID,D1.FINPROD_ID,NVL(D1.TRADE_AMT,0) actTotalAmt, d1.unit_int actUnitBonusVlu,d1.SHARE_AMT regDateNum FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL D1 WHERE D1.BUSI_TYPE=#{BUSI_TYPE,jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND D1.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16,jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND D1.PS='C8' AND D1.TRADE_STATUS='01' ) D1 ON A.BONUS_PLAN_ID=D1.B_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT D1.B_TRADE_ID,D1.FINPROD_ID,SUM(NVL(D1.TRADE_AMT,0)) totalBonusCashAmt FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL D1 WHERE D1.BUSI_TYPE=#{BUSI_TYPE,jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND D1.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16,jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND D1.PS in('C9','C10') AND D1.TRADE_STATUS='01' GROUP BY D1.B_TRADE_ID,D1.FINPROD_ID ) D2 ON D1.TRADE_ID=D2.B_TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD padd ON padd.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND B.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND A.DEL_DATE = #{dealdate, jdbcType = DATE} AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 AND FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND FINPROD_MARKET_ID = trim(#{finprodCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIN_PRODUCT_SEND_INFO (FINPROD_ID, SEND_STATUS, SEND_REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CONTRACT_NO) VALUES (#{finprodid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sendstatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sendremark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createuser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdept, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{updateuser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{contractno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(BOK_POSITION_PRD.TDY_UNIT_VALUE, 1) NETVALUE FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD, (SELECT MAX(BPR.CDATE) CDATE, BPR.FINPROD_ID FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD BPR WHERE BPR.CDATE <= #{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY BPR.FINPROD_ID) POSITION WHERE POSITION.CDATE = BOK_POSITION_PRD.CDATE AND POSITION.FINPROD_ID = BOK_POSITION_PRD.FINPROD_ID AND POSITION.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
